question: PSLV is a:
solution:
The correct answer is __**satellite launch vehicle of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• PSLV stands for Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle.
 
• It is an expendable launch vehicle designed and operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• PSLV is used to launch satellites into polar orbits and geosynchronous transfer orbits.
 
• It has a high success rate and is known for its reliability and versatility in launching various types of payloads.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO**

 
 
• The Indian Space Research Organisation is the space agency of the Government of India, headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• It is responsible for space research, exploration, and the development of space technology.
 
• ISRO has launched numerous successful missions including Chandrayaan and Mangalyaan.
 
 
 
• **Satellite Orbits**
 
 
• Polar orbits are those in which the satellite passes over the Earth's poles, providing global coverage.
 
• Geosynchronous Transfer Orbits (GTO) are elliptical orbits used to transfer satellites to geostationary orbits.
 
 
 
• **Launch Vehicles**
 
 
• Launch vehicles are used to transport satellites and other payloads into space.
 
• They include various types like expendable launch vehicles (ELVs) and reusable launch vehicles (RLVs).
 
 
 
• **Payloads**
 
 
• Payloads are the satellites or instruments carried by a launch vehicle.
 
• They can be used for various purposes including communication, earth observation, and scientific research.
